candidates.explanation: The access-token strategy verifies tokens with 'auth.refreshSecret', but access tokens are signed in AuthService.getTokensData with 'auth.secret'. The signature check always fails, so every request with a valid fresh access token gets 401. Login and refresh still work because the refresh strategy correctly uses refreshSecret.

fix.description: Use 'auth.secret' as secretOrKey in JwtStrategy so it matches the secret used to sign access tokens.
